plugin_maps.title: Map service
plugin_maps.desc: Free basic map plugin: enable AMap, Baidu or Google as needed. Picking runs in the browser; reverse geocoding goes through the server proxy.
plugin_maps.configDesc: Fill in the providers you enable. Server keys stay on the backend; the API only reports whether one exists.

keys.amapHint: AMap console: create a Web (JS API) key and a Web service key. The former ships to the browser; the latter is only used for server-side reverse geocoding.
keys.baiduHint: Baidu console: apply for a browser AK and a server AK; enable reverse geocoding for the server AK.
keys.googleHint: Google Cloud: enable Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API. Maps usually fail to load in mainland China; intended for overseas deployments.

plugin_maps.demoDesc: Pick an enabled provider, click the map or drag the marker, then confirm. The coordinate system follows the provider (gcj02 / bd09 / wgs84).
plugin_maps.notConfigured: This provider is disabled or missing its browser key. Save the keys and reopen.
plugin_maps.googleLoadFailed: Failed to load the Google Maps script. Networks in mainland China usually cannot reach it directly.
plugin_maps.googleGlobalMissing: The Google Maps script loaded but its global object is missing. Check that the key allows this domain.
plugin_maps.clickHint: Click the map to pick a location
